title: Anesthesia consent discussion documentation

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports identity, disposition, medical, surgical and anesthetic history, medicines, allergies and reactions, fasting, advance directives, airway and cardiopulmonary examination, tests, consultations, ASA status, plan…
user_facing_items.population: Patients receiving anesthesia services across preanesthesia, intraoperative, and postanesthesia phases.
user_facing_items.setting: Anesthesia care continuum and anesthesia medical records.
restrictions: Exact for documentation fields and continuity of anesthesia records. It supports recording clinician-assessed facts and completed plans, not generating management, medicines, doses, procedures, referrals, discharge, or urgency.
user_facing_items.rationale: The exact ASA section supports recording that anesthesia risks, benefits, alternatives, and consent were discussed by the responsible clinician; it does not create consent. The exact ASA preanesthesia documentation section supports risk, airway, cardiorespiratory, reviewed-investigation, consultation, plan, and consent fields for Anesthesia consent discussion documentation; each remains clinician-entered and conditional on assessment.
